design: Longitudinal secondary analysis of two versioned O*NET database releases
source_name: O*NET 25.1 Technology Skills and O*NET 31.0 Software Skills
license_note: O*NET database releases are available under CC BY 4.0 with required USDOL/ETA attribution.
claim_boundary: Database change combines labor-market change, taxonomy maintenance, data-collection updates, software/vendor naming changes, and measurement revisions. Pair churn is therefore a renewal-pressure indicator, not a pure rate of human skill depreciation.
